<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant M peak with a ~12.5% M+1, ~1% M+2, and rapidly decreasing higher peaks—the pattern matches the binomial distribution of 13C isotopes in a carbon‑rich molecule. No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
